Alex (support): Hey @alice, sorry you're hitting a 413 on /v1/rerank. Can you paste the exact error body and the request payload (query + docs array size)?
Alice (acme-corp): Here's what we see: "413 Payload Too Large" — no JSON details. Our curl: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query":"<very long query...>","docs":[{"id":"1","text":"...very long..."}, {"id":"2","text":"..."} /* ~1200 docs */]}'
```
Alice: We also saw intermittent 401s earlier but those cleared after rotating the key.
Alex (support): Thanks — quick triage: your payload shows a very long query plus ~1200 docs. Our rerank endpoint enforces a combined token ceiling (query + concatenated doc contexts). When that ceiling is exceeded we return 413. Right now the returned body is generic which makes it hard to debug.
Alex (support): If you can run a tokenizer locally to estimate tokens: 
```
from tiktoken import encoding_for_model
enc = encoding_for_model('redwood/rerank-1')
q_tokens = len(enc.encode(query))
sum_doc_tokens = sum(len(enc.encode(d['text'])) for d in docs)
total = q_tokens + sum_doc_tokens
```
Devon (eng-ml): For repro, I reduced docs to top 200 snippets and the request succeeds. Two quick mitigation options: 1) send only snippets (lifecycle: embed+prune then rerank) 2) chunk docs and run multiple rerank passes.
Alice: How are tokens counted? Client or server? Also curious about billing impact — will multiple passes cost more?
Alex (support): Tokens are computed server-side; we count input tokens before processing. Multiple passes will charge per token processed, so yes cost will increase. Recommend embeddings+approximate prune to keep rerank input small.
Alex (support): I'm escalating to eng-ml to improve the error payload so we include a machine-friendly code like "input_tokens_exceeded" and fields: "limit_tokens","actual_tokens","suggested_action".
Alex (support): @devon — can you take ownership of the error payload change and a short docs blurb? Attached repro in thread.
Devon (eng-ml): Got it. I can add a clearer 413 body and example curl with chunking note. Also will add a log field we can surface to support for triage. I'll link the PR when ready. :thumbsup:
inc-bot: Escalation ticket created INC-2026-1345 and assigned to eng-ml.
Alice (acme-corp): Thanks — we'll try snippets and report back. Appreciate the fast follow-up.
Alex (support): Great — leaving this open until PR lands and customer confirms. If you can grab the original payload (sanitized) that helps our triage logs.
